description: This file defines an enum ExecApprovalCommandDisplaySanitizer that provides static methods to sanitize a string by escaping certain invisible or formatting unicode characters, primarily for display sanitization purposes.

methods.name: sanitize
methods.description: Sanitizes the input text by escaping invisible or formatting Unicode scalars.

methods.name: shouldEscape
methods.description: Determines if a Unicode scalar should be escaped based on its character properties or if it is an invisible code point.

methods.name: escape
methods.description: Converts a Unicode scalar into its escaped string representation.
